rule_or_requirement: Maintain valid completion first, then improve finished lap time with a pixel-only policy.
observable_information: Rendered HUD speed and student posterior; matched completion, lap, progress, collision, action and latency evidence on fresh TUNE cells.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Suppress only learned extra gas at rendered speed 54 or higher; retain selected pixel driver's steering, braking and base gas.
expected_success_endpoint: At least selected and original student valid completion, zero invalid actions, active suppression and retained acceleration, then at least 2% paired median speed gain if completion ties selected.
control: Exact selected stable-risk pixel driver and original student on the same twelve fresh TUNE cells.
falsifier: Fewer valid finishes than either control, invalid actions, inactive saturation, or insufficient tied-completion lap improvement.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Three arms on tracks 1–3 × seeds 5216–5219, 36 registered episodes.
resource_and_risk_gate: One registered Linux CPU diagnostic capped at 1,800 seconds and 2,000 decisions per episode; no confirmation, blind, official or external action.
